description: Canonical code-fixer input: a REVIEW.md with 2 findings + the source file. Expected output: a description of the fixes the agent would apply (not actually applied — capture mode). Schema-conformance baseline.
prompt: Spawn the gsd-code-fixer agent. Read REVIEW.md and src/index.js in the sandbox. Describe the precise fixes you would apply for each finding (file diff + rationale). Do NOT modify files in this baseline — output the diff as text. Be terse — baseline capture.

sandbox_files.REVIEW.md:
# Review Findings

## Critical

1. Off-by-one in `lastN`: `arr.slice(arr.length - n - 1)` returns N+1 elements.
   Fix: change to `arr.slice(arr.length - n)`.

## Major

2. `divide` does not handle b === 0 (returns Infinity / -Infinity / NaN silently).
   Fix: throw on b === 0.
